Definite noun (GERUND_INSTANT), accusative case (direct object of radadnā). From root k-r-r. The definite article al- marks THIS specific return/turn, not a generic one. The tā' marbūṭa indicates the feminine singular. The pattern faʿla (karra) is a noun of single instance (ism al-marra), meaning "one occurrence of returning/charging."

PREP بِ (instrumental bāʾ) + indefinite noun أَمْوَٰلٍ (broken plural of māl), genitive governed by bi-, with tanwīn indicating unspecified/abundant wealth; together: instrumental phrase "by means of [unspecified] wealth"

Masculine plural noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive case (coordinated with amwālin under bi-). Sound masculine plural of ibn (son), from root b-n-y. The form banīna (rather than abnā') is the standard Quranic plural for "sons" in the general/generic sense.

Comparative adjective (ADJ_COMP), accusative case (second accusative of jaʿala, serving as predicate complement). From root k-th-r. Pattern afʿal (elative form) meaning "more" or "most." Here in the accusative as the result-state: "We made you MORE [in nafīr]."

Indefinite accusative adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), functioning as تَمْيِيز (tamyīz, accusative of specification): specifying WHAT they are "more" in. Root n-f-r. The pattern faʿīl (nafīr) can be an adjective or noun.
Broken plural of nafs, genitive (governed by لِ), with 2MP possessive pronoun -kum; NOUN_ABSTRACT functioning as the beneficiary of ihsaan
Verbal noun (masdar), nominative as subject of jaa'a, in construct state (idaafa) with al-aakhira
Active participle feminine, genitive in construct (mudaaf ilayh), definite -- "the last [one]" or "the hereafter"
Noun plural concrete, accusative as object of yasuu'uu, with possessive pronoun 2MP -- wujuuh (faces/directions)
Noun of place (maf'il pattern), accusative as object of yadkhuluu, definite with al-
Ordinal numeral, accusative as temporal adverb (zarf zamaan) -- modifies the time of entry
Gerund of instance (masdar marratan), genitive in construct with awwala -- "the first time/occasion"
Verbal noun (masdar), accusative as cognate accusative (maf'uul mutlaq) -- emphasizing the verb li-yutabbiruu
Noun, nominative (marfū'), subject of 'asā; masculine singular with 2nd person masculine plural possessive suffix -kum
PREP لِ (lām al-takhṣīṣ / lām al-tamlīk, assignment/designation) + NOUN_ACTIVE_PART كَافِرِينَ definite masculine plural in genitive; marks the kāfirīn as the designated recipients of ḥaṣīr
Qualitative adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), accusative (manṣūb) as second object of ja'alnā (object complement); tanwīn indicates indefinite

Definite concrete noun, accusative case (apposition to hādhā, governed by inna). From root q-r-' meaning to read, to recite, to gather/compile. The definite article al- makes it specific — "the Quran" as a known entity.

Elative adjective (ism tafḍīl) from the root q-w-m, pattern af'alu. Predicate (khabar) of the nominal clause hiya aqwamu. Means "most upright, straightest, most firmly established." The elative form indicates superlative degree.

Active participle (ism fā'il), masculine plural, definite with al-, accusative case (direct object of yubashshiru). Form IV participle mu'min — one who has entered the state of īmān (giving security/trust). The genitive/accusative ending -īna reflects the jamʿ mudhakkar sālim pattern.

Active participle (ism fā'il), feminine plural, definite with al-, genitive/accusative case (direct object of ya'malūna). From root s-l-h meaning to be righteous, to be sound, to repair/restore. The feminine plural with al- creates a generic category: "the righteous things/deeds."

Indefinite gerund (maṣdar), accusative case functioning as the subject (ism) of the anna-clause (delayed subject after the fronted predicate lahum). The tanwīn marks indefiniteness — "a reward" not "the reward," suggesting open-ended magnitude.

Qualitative adjective (ṣifa), masculine singular, indefinite, accusative case (qualifying ajran). From root k-b-r meaning to be great, large, old, senior. The tanwīn matches ajran in case, number, gender, and definiteness.

Prepositional phrase: PREP بِ (bāʾ al-ilṣāq / taʿdiya) + definite NOUN_ABSTRACT ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ in genitive (majrūr); active participle pattern fāʿila used substantively; bi- marks the object of belief with yuʾminūna — "believe in the ākhira"

Noun (maṣdar/verbal noun), masculine singular, indefinite, accusative (naṣb) — direct object of aʿtadnā. From root '-dh-b. The tanwīn (indefinite) is significant: "a punishment" rather than "the punishment" — non-specification amplifies the threat. The accusative case marks it as what has been prepared.

Adjective (ṣifa), masculine singular, indefinite, accusative (naṣb) — qualifies ʿadhāban. Pattern: faʿīl. From root '-l-m (pain). The faʿīl pattern can be passive (= "pained, suffering") or active (= "causing pain"). Here likely active: "a punishment that causes pain." The alīm-ʿadhāb collocation is the Quran's most common punishment descriptor.
Definite noun, nominative (marfūʿ), functioning as subject (fāʿil) of yadʿū. The definite article al- marks generic reference: "the human [as a species]" not a particular individual. Root '-n-s.
Compound: PREP بِ (bāʾ al-jarr, content / instrument / causation) + definite NOUN_ABSTRACT ٱلشَّرِّ (genitive governed by bi-); marks the content of human invocation — what the human calls for

Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund) in accusative (manṣūb), functioning as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq) modifying yadʿū. The pronoun suffix -hū refers back to al-insān. Root d-ʿ-w. This cognate accusative equates the intensity: "he calls for evil [with a calling] like his calling for good."

Compound: PREP بِ (bāʾ al-jarr, content / instrument / accompaniment) + definite NOUN_ABSTRACT ٱلْخَيْرِ (genitive governed by bi-); parallel to bi-sh-sharr (words 4-5), marks the content of the comparison invocation — calling for good
Definite noun, nominative (marfūʿ), subject (ism kāna, with raised case per kāna syntax). Second occurrence of al-insān in this ayah. Same root '-n-s as word 3.

Qualitative adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha), accusative (manṣūb) as predicate of kāna (khabar kāna). Pattern faʿūl — intensive/habitual form indicating a permanent characteristic, not a temporary state. Root ʿ-j-l.
noun, accusative singular, definite with al-; first object of ja'alnā
noun, accusative singular, definite; second object of ja'alnā, paired with al-layla
noun, accusative dual; second object of ja'alnā (complement predicate) -- night and day are rendered as "two signs"
noun, accusative singular; object of maḥawnā; in genitive construct with al-layli
noun, genitive singular; second element of construct āyat al-layli
noun, accusative singular; object of ja'alnā; in genitive construct with al-nahāri
noun, genitive singular; second element of construct āyat al-nahāri
active participle (Form IV), feminine singular accusative; complement/second object of ja'alnā -- describes the day-sign
verbal noun (gerund/maṣdar), accusative singular indefinite; object of tabtaghū
noun, genitive singular (governed by min); with 2nd person masculine plural possessive suffix -kum
noun, accusative singular; object of ta'lamū; in genitive construct with al-sinīna
verbal noun (gerund/maṣdar), accusative singular, definite; second object of ta'lamū, coordinated with 'adad al-sinīn
noun, accusative singular; fronted object of faṣṣalnāhu (topicalized for emphasis); in genitive construct with shay'in
noun, genitive singular indefinite; second element of construct kull shay'in
verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), accusative singular indefinite; cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) of faṣṣala
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), accusative case (manṣūb) — fronted object of alzamnāhu; governs following noun insānin in genitive (iḍāfa)
Noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive (majrūr) — in iḍāfa with kulla; indefinite (tankīr) — any/every human without specification
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), accusative (manṣūb) — second object of alzama (double accusative: alzamnāhu ṭā'irahu); active participle form (fāʿil pattern) from ṭāra "to fly"; possessive pronoun -hu
Noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive (majrūr by fī), singular with possessive pronoun -hi; physical body part used metaphorically for responsibility/obligation
Noun (NOUN_PROP), genitive (majrūr) — in iḍāfa with yawma; definite with al-; verbal noun pattern (qiyāma from qāma = to stand/rise)
Noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), accusative indefinite (tanwīn) — object of nukhriju; from kataba = "to write"
Noun (NOUN_PASSIVE_PART), accusative indefinite — ḥāl (circumstantial state) describing kitāb: "a record [while it is] spread open"; passive participle (maf'ūl pattern) from nashara
Noun, masculine singular, accusative (naṣb) as direct object of iqra', with 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka; from root k-t-b
Noun, feminine singular, genitive (jarr) governed by بِ; with attached 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka ("your")
Adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), accusative (naṣb) as tamyīz (accusative of specification), indefinite; fa'īl pattern from root h-s-b; specifies in what capacity the self suffices
Noun, genitive (majrūr by li), with 3rd masculine singular possessive pronoun
Active participle (ism fāʿil), feminine singular, indefinite (tanwīn), nominative (marfūʿ) as subject of taziru
Noun (maṣdar/abstract noun), accusative (manṣūb) as object of taziru, in genitive construction with ukhrā
Adjective (comparative/superlative form afʿal), feminine singular, genitive (majrūr) in genitive construction with wizra
Active participle (ism fāʿil), masculine plural, accusative (khabar kāna), Form II (mufa''il pattern)
Noun (concrete), accusative (manṣūb) as object of nabʿatha, indefinite (tanwīn)
Noun, indefinite accusative (nakirah manṣūba), serving as the object of nuhlika. The tanwīn (ـًۭ) marks indefiniteness, universalizing the referent: any qarya, not a specific one.

Passive participle, masculine plural accusative (muʿrab, iʿrāb: yāʾ for naṣb) + possessive pronoun -hā (referring to qaryatan). The passive participle mutraf = "one who has been given luxury, made comfortable" — the passivity implies they did not earn their affluence but were provided it. Functions as the object of amarnā.

Definite noun, nominative (marfūʿ), functioning as the subject (fāʿil) of ḥaqqa. The definite article al- indicates a specific, known decree — THE word, not just any word. This is the divine verdict of destruction.

Gerund (maṣdar), Form II, accusative indefinite. Functions as مفعول مطلق (mafʿūl muṭlaq, cognate accusative) — reinforcing the verb dammarnā. The cognate accusative intensifies: "We destroyed it A DESTROYING" = "We destroyed it utterly."
noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), definite with al-, genitive (majrūr by min), plural of qarn
noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), genitive (majrūr by min), iḍāfa first term to nūḥin
proper noun (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN), genitive (iḍāfa second term to ba'di), tanwīn indicates non-Arabic origin or diptote

Pleonastic bā' (bā' zā'ida) of the kafā construction + NOUN_CONCRETE rabb in formal genitive (majrūr by bi-) but functionally fā'il (subject of kafā), with 2nd person masculine singular possessive suffix -ka
Preposition bi (sababiyya/concerning, possibly instrumental or muṣāḥaba) + NOUN_ABSTRACT dhunūb (plural of dhanb) in genitive (majrūr by bi-), iḍāfa first term to 'ibādihi
noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive (iḍāfa second term to dhunūbi), with third person masculine singular pronoun -hi
adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), accusative (tamyīz/ḥāl — specification of manner in kafā construction), indefinite
adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), accusative (tamyīz/ḥāl — second specification in kafā construction), indefinite

Definite noun (active participle used as substantive), accusative singular feminine, functioning as direct object of yurīdu. The alif-lām makes it a known referent — "the immediate one" (i.e., this worldly life, or any transient gain).

Passive participle (ism mafʿūl), accusative singular masculine indefinite (tanwīn). Functions as ḥāl (circumstantial accusative) describing the subject's state while burning in Jahannam. From Form I faʿala.
Passive participle (ism mafʿūl), accusative singular masculine indefinite (tanwīn). Functions as ḥāl (second circumstantial accusative) alongside madhmūman. From Form I faʿala.
Active participle (ism fāʿil) functioning as noun, accusative (manṣūb) as direct object of arāda. Feminine form of ākhir (last, latter). From '-kh-r: to delay, to come after, to be behind.

Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund) in accusative as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq). From s-'-y: striving, effort, exertion. Attached feminine singular pronoun hā refers to al-ākhirata. The cognate accusative specifies the TYPE and MEASURE of effort: the exertion that belongs to the ākhira itself.

Active participle (ism fāʿil), Form IV (muʾmin from āmana), masculine singular nominative (marfūʿ) as predicate (khabar) of the nominal clause wa-huwa muʾmin. From '-m-n: to be safe, to be secure, to trust, to believe. Form IV: to make safe, to grant security, to trust in.

Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), nominative (marfūʿ) as subject (ism kāna) of kāna. Third occurrence of s-'-y in this ayah. Attached masculine plural pronoun hum refers to ulāʾika. Shift from singular (saʿyahā — the ākhira's standard) to plural (saʿyuhum — their collective effort).

Passive participle (ism mafʿūl), Form I, masculine singular accusative (manṣūb) as predicate (khabar kāna). From sh-k-r: to thank, to be grateful, to acknowledge. Passive: "being thanked, being acknowledged, being appreciated." Only 2 occurrences as NOUN_PASSIVE_PART in the entire Quran (here and 76:22).

Accusative indefinite noun (manṣūb, tanwīn). Functions as mafʿūl bihi muqaddam (fronted object) of numiddu, or as accusative of specification (tamyīz). Fronting creates emphasis: "each one" is the topic, placed before the verb for prominence.
Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund) in genitive (majrūr) governed by min. First term of an iḍāfa construction with rabbika. Functions as the source of numiddu — what is being extended comes from the ʿaṭāʾ.

Noun in genitive (majrūr) as second term of iḍāfa with ʿaṭāʾi. Attached pronoun -ka (2nd person masculine singular) addresses the Prophet or any reader. Root r-b-b = to nurture, to raise, to be lord/master.
Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund) in nominative (marfūʿ) as subject (ism kāna) of the copular verb kāna. Second occurrence of ʿaṭāʾ in the ayah — now as the grammatical subject being declared unrestricted.
Noun in genitive (majrūr) as second term of iḍāfa with ʿaṭāʾu. Second occurrence in the ayah — same form, same meaning, reinforcing the frame.

Passive participle (ism mafʿūl) from ḥ-ẓ-r, indefinite accusative (manṣūb) functioning as predicate (khabar kāna). The pattern mafʿūl indicates the state of being restricted/enclosed. With mā kāna: "was never in the state of being restricted."

Noun (ism), accusative case (manṣūb) as direct object of faḍḍalnā. Attached pronoun -hum (3rd person masculine plural) refers to those being discussed in context (humanity, per preceding ayahs 17:18-20). Indefinite in reference though definite in form through the pronoun.

Noun (ism), genitive case (majrūr) governed by ʿalā. Without attached pronoun (unlike baʿḍahum in word 4), creating deliberate asymmetry — the favored group is specified (-hum), the baseline group is left open (bare baʿḍ).
Definite noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT) with lām al-ibtidāʾ + definite article al-; nominative as subject (mubtadaʾ) of the nominal sentence; from '-kh-r = to be last/later

Elative/comparative adjective (ism tafḍīl), nominative as predicate (khabar) of the nominal sentence whose subject is al-ākhiratu. Pattern afʿalu. From k-b-r = to be great, large, old. Followed by tamyīz (accusative of specification) darajātin.

Noun (ism), accusative case as tamyīz (specification) after akbaru — specifies the dimension in which the Hereafter is "greater." Indefinite plural (broken plural of daraja). Tanwīn indicates non-specificity of the degrees.
Elative/comparative adjective (ism tafḍīl), nominative as second predicate (khabar thānī) of al-ākhiratu, coordinated with the first akbaru via wāw. Followed by tamyīz tafḍīlā.

Verbal noun (maṣdar) of Form II faḍḍala, accusative case as tamyīz (specification) after akbaru. Indefinite with tanwīn. Pattern tafʿīl. Cognate accusative relationship with the verb faḍḍalnā earlier in the same ayah — the verbal noun echoes the verb.
Proper noun (اسم علم, ism 'alam), genitive case (مجرور, majrūr) governed by the preceding ma'a. The definite form of ilāh with the definite article assimilated.
Common noun (اسم نكرة, ism nakira), accusative case (منصوب, manṣūb) — first object of taj'al. The indefinite form contrasts with the definite Allāh: a deity (any) vs. THE God (specific).

Comparative adjective (اسم تفضيل, ism tafḍīl), accusative case (منصوب, manṣūb) — attributive adjective modifying ilāhan. Diptote (ممنوع من الصرف, mamnū' min al-ṣarf): no tanwīn despite being indefinite.

Passive participle (اسم مفعول, ism maf'ūl), accusative case — functioning as ḥāl (حال, circumstantial accusative) describing the state of the subject of taq'uda. Form I passive participle pattern (maf'ūl).

Passive participle (اسم مفعول, ism maf'ūl), accusative case — functioning as second ḥāl (حال, circumstantial accusative) alongside madhmūman. Form I passive participle pattern (maf'ūl). The root kh-dh-l has only 3 total occurrences in the Quran.
noun, nominative (AGNT/subject), masculine singular with 2ms possessive suffix -ka
Noun (active participle), dual form, genitive governed by بِ, definite with al-; from w-l-d (to beget, to generate)
verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), Form IV (ifʿāl pattern), accusative indefinite, functioning as cognate accusative
verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), accusative definite, object of yablughanna
noun (numerical), nominative (AGNT/subject of yablughanna), with 3rd dual suffix -humā
noun (abstract), nominative, conjoined subject (CONJ_N), with 3rd dual suffix -humā
noun (noun-verb-like / interjection), genitive with tanwīn, functions as INTERJ_IV; onomatopoeia
verbal noun (gerund/maṣdar), accusative indefinite, cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) of qul
adjective (qualitative), accusative indefinite, modifying qawlan
noun, accusative singular, direct object of ikhfid; construct state (idafah with al-dhull)
gerund (masdar), genitive singular definite, second term of idafah with janah
gerund (masdar), genitive singular definite, governed by min
noun, vocative case with yaa al-mutakallim (1st person possessive), address to God
qualitative adjective, accusative singular indefinite, circumstantial (hal) — describing state during rabbayani
Noun, nominative, masculine singular with 2nd person masculine plural possessive pronoun -kum; subject of nominal sentence
Elative adjective (af'alu pattern), nominative; predicate of nominal sentence with rabbukum
Noun, genitive plural (broken plural of nafs), with 2nd person masculine plural possessive -kum; object of preposition fi
Active participle, masculine plural, accusative (predicate of takūnū); from Form I ṣalaḥa
Intensive adjective (fa''āl pattern), masculine plural, genitive (governed by li); active participle of intensification from āba (to return)
Intensive adjective (fa'ūl pattern), masculine singular, accusative (predicate of kāna, also known as khabar kāna); from ghafara
Gerund (verbal noun) with definite article, genitive by construct (iḍāfa) with dhā. From q-r-b: to be near, to approach. al-qurbā = nearness, closeness, kinship (the quality of being near).

Gerund (verbal noun) in accusative, functioning as second direct object of āti (double-accusative construction). Suffixed with 3ms pronoun -hu referring back to dhā l-qurbā. ḥaqq = right, due, truth, reality, established fact.

Intensive adjective (ṣīghat mubālagha: mif'īl pattern) from s-k-n (to be still, to settle, to dwell). Accusative singular with definite article, functioning as conjoined direct object of āti. miskīn = one who has been rendered still/immobile by poverty — more intense than faqīr (poor).
Concrete noun in accusative (conjoined object of āti). Part of the compound ibn al-sabīl (child of the road). From b-n-y: to build, to construct; ibn = son, offspring, product.
Abstract noun with definite article, genitive by construct (iḍāfa: ibn al-sabīl). From s-b-l: to let flow, to release, to let hang. sabīl = way, road, path, course — that which flows or is left open.

Gerund (verbal noun) of Form II, accusative, functioning as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq) reinforcing the verb tubadh-dhir. tabdhīr = the act of scattering/squandering. The cognate accusative intensifies the prohibition absolutely.

Active participle (ism fāʿil) of Form II (tafʿīl), masculine plural in accusative case (governed by inna). Pattern: mu-fa''il-īn. Form II indicates intensive/causative action — one who habitually or intensively scatters.

Noun (ism), masculine plural in accusative case — predicate (khabar) of kāna. Broken plural of akh (brother). In construct state (muḍāf) governing ash-shayāṭīn in genitive. The iḍāfa "ikhwān ash-shayāṭīn" establishes a categorical kinship relationship.
Noun (ism), masculine plural in genitive case — second term of iḍāfa (governed by ikhwān). Broken plural of shayṭān. Definite with al-.

Noun (ism), masculine singular in nominative case — subject (ism kāna) of the copular verb kāna. Definite with al-. Second occurrence of sh-ṭ-n root in this ayah, now singular (archetype) rather than plural (class).

Compound: PREP لِ (lām al-ikhtiṣāṣ — specification, governing genitive) + noun رَبّ in genitive (majrūr) + 3rd person masculine singular possessive pronoun ـهِ referring back to ash-shayṭān; specifies the recipient/target toward whom the kafūr disposition is directed

Intensive adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha or fa'ūl pattern), indefinite accusative — predicate (khabar) of kāna. Pattern fa'ūl indicates intensity and habituation: not merely kāfir (one who covers) but kafūr (one who covers intensely and persistently).

Form VIII verbal noun (maṣdar), accusative. Functions as maf'ūl li-ajlih (accusative of purpose/reason): the seeking explains WHY the turning away occurs. Form VIII iftā'ala pattern adds reflexive meaning — seeking actively for oneself.

Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), genitive singular indefinite (tanwīn kasra). Genitive as second term of iḍāfa construct with ibtighā'a. The tanwīn + indefiniteness suggests mercy here is non-specific — any instance of divine mercy/provision, not a particular one.
Noun, genitive (governed by min), with 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka. From r-b-b: the one who rears, sustains, nourishes, cultivates. Construct state (muḍāf).

Verbal noun (maṣdar), accusative singular indefinite. Functions as cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) with qul — "say a saying." The cognate accusative intensifies and qualifies the speech act: not just "say something" but "say a particular kind of saying."

Passive participle (ism maf'ūl) from Form I yasara, pattern maf'ūl. Accusative indefinite, qualifying qawlan. As passive participle: "made easy, facilitated, smoothed" — the ease is done TO the speech by an external agent (implicitly: God). This is the ONLY occurrence of maysūr in the Quran.
noun, concrete, accusative singular + 2nd masc. sg. possessive pronoun -ka; first object of taj'al
passive participle (ism maf'ūl), Form I, feminine singular accusative, indefinite; second object of taj'al (predicate state)
noun, concrete, genitive singular (governed by ilā) + 2nd masc. sg. possessive -ka
noun, abstract, accusative (cognate accusative / maf'ūl muṭlaq modifying tabsuṭhā); emphasizes totality of the extension
gerund (maṣdar), genitive (iḍāfa with kulla); definite with al-; cognate object of tabsuṭhā
passive participle (ism maf'ūl), Form I, masculine singular accusative indefinite; ḥāl (circumstantial state) of the subject of taq'uda
passive participle (ism maf'ūl), Form I, masculine singular accusative indefinite; second ḥāl (circumstantial state)
Noun, masculine singular, accusative (ism of inna), with 2nd person masculine singular possessive suffix -ka; from r-b-b
Noun, masculine singular, accusative definite (direct object of yabsuṭu); gerund form (maṣdar) of r-z-q

Preposition bi (relation/concerning, marks domain of divine knowledge) + NOUN 'ibād (broken plural of 'abd), masculine plural, genitive (majrūr by bi-), with 3rd person masculine singular possessive suffix -hī
Adjective, masculine singular indefinite accusative (predicate of kāna, V_COP_PRED); intensive pattern fa'īl; describes inner knowledge
Adjective, masculine singular indefinite accusative (second predicate of kāna, V_COP_PRED); intensive pattern fa'īl; describes outer perception
noun, concrete, masculine plural (broken plural of walad), accusative (direct object), with 2nd person masculine plural possessive suffix -kum
gerund (maṣdar), accusative (maf'ūl li-ajlihi / purpose accusative), in iḍāfa with imlāq
noun, abstract (maṣdar of Form IV amlaq), genitive (second term of iḍāfa with khashyata)
gerund (maṣdar), accusative (ism of inna), with 3rd person masculine plural possessive suffix -hum
gerund (maṣdar), accusative (predicate of kāna), indefinite
adjective, qualitative, accusative (naʿt/attribute of khiṭʾan), indefinite, masculine singular

Definite noun (maṣdar/gerund), accusative case (manṣūb) as direct object of تَقْرَبُوا. The alif maqṣūra ending (ىٰ) marks it as a defective noun. The definite article ال indicates the category as a whole, not a specific instance. Root z-n-y has only 8 Quranic occurrences total.

Indefinite noun (ism), accusative case (manṣūb) as predicate (khabar) of كَانَ. Pattern fāʿila — active participle form used as abstract noun. Feminine singular with tāʾ marbūṭa. The indefinite form (without al-) emphasizes the qualitative nature: not "the violation" but "a violation" — it belongs to the category of violations.

Indefinite noun, accusative case (manṣūb) functioning as tamyīz (specification) for the verb of dispraise سَآءَ. The indefinite form emphasizes the qualitative aspect — "as a path." Root s-b-l is one of the most frequent in the Quran (176 occurrences), covering physical roads, moral courses, and divine paths.
NOUN_ABSTRACT accusative definite; direct object of taqtulu
NOUN_PROP nominative; subject (agent) of harrama
GERUND genitive definite; object of preposition bi
NOUN_PASSIVE_PART accusative indefinite; circumstantial accusative (hal) describing the state of the one killed
NOUN_CONCRETE genitive with 3rd person masculine singular possessive pronoun; object of preposition li
NOUN_ABSTRACT accusative indefinite; direct object of ja'alna (the thing made/established)
GERUND genitive definite; verbal noun of qatala, object of preposition fi
NOUN_PASSIVE_PART accusative indefinite; predicate of kana (the state established)
noun concrete accusative singular, object of taqrabū; in iḍāfa with al-yatīm
adjective qualitative genitive singular definite, second term of iḍāfa with māl
elative adjective (af'alu pattern), predicative position; from ḥ-s-n; can be comparative (better) or superlative (best)
noun abstract accusative singular with 3ms possessive pronoun -hu; object of yablugha; pattern af'ul (irregular plural or masdar)
Gerund; genitive governed by بِ; definite with al-; the object of the command to fulfill
gerund accusative singular definite; ism inna (subject of inna, in accusative); same root as word 15
passive participle (maf'ūl pattern) accusative singular indefinite; from saʾala (I): to ask, question, inquire; khabar kāna (predicate of kāna)

Definite noun, accusative (manṣūb), direct object of awfū. Gerund (maṣdar) from kāla/yakīlu meaning to measure by volume. The definite article al- makes it generic: the act of measuring itself, not a specific instance.

Compound: PREP بِ (bāʾ al-istiʿāna — instrumental, governing genitive) + definite noun ٱلْقِسْطَاس in genitive (majrūr); specifies the instrument with which weighing is performed. The quadriliteral root q-s-t-s appears only twice in the entire Quran (17:35 and 26:182); possibly a non-Arabic loanword (Greek/Syriac stathmos via qisṭās), or derived from the Arabic root q-s-ṭ (justice, equity) with intensification.

Active participle of Form X (istaqāma/yastaqīmu), genitive, functioning as adjective modifying al-qisṭāsi. Form X of q-w-m: to seek straightness, to be upright, to stand correctly. The Form X adds reflexive-estimative force: the balance that establishes itself as straight.

Comparative adjective (ism tafḍīl), nominative, functioning as predicate (khabar) of dhālika. Though morphologically comparative (af'al pattern → khayr), it can function as both comparative ("better") and absolute ("good"). Here likely comparative: "that is better [than the alternative of cheating]."

Comparative adjective (ism tafḍīl, af'al pattern), nominative, second predicate (khabar thānī) of dhālika. From ḥasuna (to be beautiful, good, excellent). aḥsanu governs ta'wīlā as tamyīz (accusative of specification): "better/more beautiful in terms of outcome."

Gerund (maṣdar) of Form II awwala (to interpret, to trace to origin), accusative functioning as tamyīz (specification) after aḥsanu. The ta'wīl specifies in what respect the practice is aḥsan: in its outcome, consequence, or ultimate return. From '-w-l: to return to origin.
GERUND nominative indefinite, functioning as ism of laysa (subject of the negated copula). Tanwin indicates indefiniteness -- any knowledge at all.
GERUND accusative definite (ism of inna). The auditory faculty, first in the triad of perceptive faculties.
NOUN_ABSTRACT accusative definite, second element in inna's compound ism. The visual faculty.
NOUN_CONCRETE accusative definite, third element in inna's compound ism. The seat of inner cognition and emotion.
NOUN_ABSTRACT nominative definite by iḍāfa to ulā'ika. Functions as mubtada' (subject) of the clause kāna 'anhu mas'ūlā.
NOUN_PASSIVE_PART accusative indefinite, predicate of kāna. Passive participle of Form I: one who is questioned.
Definite noun, feminine singular, genitive (majrūr) governed by fī. Root '-r-ḍ = earth, land, ground.

Indefinite verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), accusative. Functions as ḥāl (circumstantial accusative) describing the manner of walking — "walking in a state of maraḥ." Alternatively, read as mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) reinforcing the nature of the walking.

Definite noun, feminine singular, accusative (manṣūb) as direct object of takhriqa. Same root as word 5 but in different syntactic role — from prepositional object (genitive) to verb object (accusative).
Definite noun, masculine broken plural (singular: jabal), accusative (manṣūb) as direct object of tablugha. Root j-b-l = mountain, to mold, to create.

Indefinite abstract noun, accusative. Functions as tamyīz (accusative of specification/discrimination) — specifying the dimension in which the mountains cannot be reached: "in terms of height." Root ṭ-w-l = to be long/tall, length, height, power, favor.
Noun in nominative (marfūʿ), muḍāf (first term of iḍāfa with ذَلِكَ). Functions as subject of the sentence or mubtadaʾ with كَانَ سَيِّئُهُ as khabar.
Adjective used as noun (ADJ_QUALIT), nominative (ism of kāna). Intensive form (fayyiʿul) from root s-w-'. Attached pronoun هُ refers back to ذَلِكَ. This is the subject of كَانَ.
Noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive (majrūr) governed by عِندَ. Muḍāf with attached pronoun كَ (2nd person masculine singular, addressing the Prophet or any reader).
Passive participle (NOUN_PASSIVE_PART), accusative (manṣūb) — functions as predicate of كَانَ (khabar kāna). Pattern mafʿūl from root k-r-h. Gender: masculine singular, agreeing with سَيِّئُهُ.
Noun, masculine singular, nominative (subject of awḥā); construct state with 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka; agent of the revelation
Noun (gerund/verbal noun), feminine singular, genitive (governed by mina); definite with al-; from root ḥ-k-m
Proper noun, genitive (governed by ma'a); the divine proper name; definite; refers to the singular deity as the exclusive authority
Noun, concrete, masculine singular, accusative indefinite (direct object of taj'al); same root as Allāh but WITHOUT the definite article — crucially indefinite, marking any generic object of worship
Adjective, comparative form (af'al pattern), masculine singular, accusative (adjective modifying ilāhan); diptote (does not take tanwīn); restricts the prohibition to adding ANOTHER, not the same

Passive participle (maf'ūl pattern), masculine singular, accusative indefinite (ḥāl — circumstantial accusative describing the state of the one cast); from root l-w-m; state of being subjected to blame
Passive participle (maf'ūl pattern), masculine singular, accusative indefinite (ḥāl — second circumstantial accusative, parallel to malūman); from root d-h-r; state of being forcefully expelled
Noun, masculine singular, nominative (subject of أَصْفَىٰكُمْ), with 2nd person masculine plural possessive suffix -kum. The rabb is the agent of the selection.

Noun, masculine plural (sound masculine plural in accusative/genitive: banīna), definite with al-, genitive governed by بِ. From b-n-y: to build, construct; ibn = son (one who builds/continues the line).
Noun, feminine plural (broken plural of malak), genitive governed by مِنَ. From m-l-k: root meaning includes sovereignty, ownership, dominion, angelic agency.

Noun, feminine plural (broken plural of ʾunthā), accusative (object of ٱتَّخَذَ). From '-n-th: to be female, feminine. The word is the second object of ittakhadha (double accusative: "He took from the angels [as] females").

Gerund/verbal noun (maṣdar), accusative singular indefinite. Functions as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq) of تَقُولُونَ — "you say a saying." The cognate accusative intensifies and qualifies the verbal action.

Adjective (ṣifa), accusative singular indefinite masculine, modifying قَوْلًا. From '-z-m: greatness, enormity, magnitude. The word carries both positive (great, grand) and negative (monstrous, grave) valences depending on context.
Definite noun in genitive (majrūr), apposition (badal) to hādhā. From root q-r-ʾ meaning "to read, to recite, to gather, to collect." The definite article makes it a specific, known text.

Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund) in accusative (manṣūb), functioning as the second object of yazīdu — specifying WHAT increases. From root n-f-r meaning "to flee, to bolt, to scatter, to be startled away."
Noun, feminine plural (broken plural of ilāh), nominative (subject of kāna existential). The indefinite form ālihatun (without al-) signals "some gods, any gods."
Noun, masculine singular, genitive (in construct after dhī). With definite article al- — THE Throne, specific and unique.
Noun, masculine/feminine (both attested), singular, indefinite accusative (maf'ūl bihi — direct object of ibtaghaw). The tanwīn (indefinite -an) leaves the nature of the "way" unspecified and open.
Cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) of implied verb yusabbiḥu; attached pronoun -hu (3ms) refers to God; accusative case (subḥāna) as verbal noun functioning as exclamatory declaration
Cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) reinforcing ta'ālā; indefinite accusative (tanwīn); GERUND of '-l-w; only 3 Quranic occurrences of this exact gerund form
Adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), masculine singular, indefinite accusative — modifies 'uluwwan (agrees in case, gender, definiteness); accusative by agreement with the cognate accusative it qualifies

Definite noun, accusative case (direct object of ḍarabū), broken plural of mathal. The definite article al- suggests known or established similitudes — not improvised but deliberate comparative frameworks.

Indefinite noun, accusative case (direct object of yastaṭī'ūna — or specifying the scope of their inability: "they cannot [find/reach] a way"). The tanwīn (indefiniteness) is critical — it is not "the way" but "any way at all," indicating absolute blockage.
noun, concrete, indefinite accusative (predicate of kunnā), broken plural of 'aẓm
noun, concrete, indefinite accusative (parallel predicate of kunnā alongside 'iẓāman), verbal noun or collective noun from rafata

Plural noun (ṣudūr) with 2nd person masculine plural possessive pronoun (-kum). Genitive after fī. ṣudūr is broken plural of ṣadr (chest/breast).

Indefinite gerund of instance (maṣdar of marra, instance noun). Genitive as second term of iḍāfa with awwala.
Plural noun (ruʾūs) with 3rd person masculine plural possessive pronoun -hum. Accusative as direct object of yunghiḍūna.
PREP بِ governing GERUND (maṣdar) حَمْد in genitive + 3rd masculine singular possessive suffix -hī (iḍāfa); bi may carry مصاحبة (accompaniment), سببية (cause), or آلة (instrument) function
Qualitative adjective in accusative, functioning as ẓarf (adverbial) or cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) modifying the implied duration of labitha
Noun ʿibād (servants, plural of ʿabd) in genitive (governed by لِ) + 1st person singular possessive pronoun -ī (My); the -ī suffix attributes the servants directly to the divine speaker

Elative/comparative adjective (ism tafḍīl, afʿalu pattern) from root ḥ-s-n. Can function as comparative (better) or superlative (best). Here in predicate position after hiya, functioning as predicate of the nominal clause within the relative clause. Diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf).

Definite noun in the accusative (ism inna, governed by inna). al- is for specificity (al-ʿahd: the known adversary). The word shayṭān is debated: from sh-ṭ-n (to be distant, to be remote from truth/good) or from sh-y-ṭ (to burn, to be consumed by rage). First occurrence in this ayah.
Definite noun in the accusative (ism inna). Second occurrence of ash-shayṭān in this ayah, now in the clause declaring his essential nature (kāna...ʿaduwwan).

Definite article ال (al-, here assimilated as l- after the preposition) + noun insān (human, human being) in genitive (governed by لِ); definite article makes it generic — the human being as a category

Intensive adjective (ṣīghat mubālagha, faʿūl pattern) in the accusative, functioning as predicate of kāna (khabar kāna). Indefinite (tanwīn). From root '-d-w which carries meanings of hostility, transgression, and running/rushing.

Active participle (ism fāʿil) from Form IV abāna (to make clear, to manifest), in the accusative indefinite. Functions as an adjective qualifying ʿaduwwan (an enemy who is mubīn). The tanwīn confirms indefiniteness, matching ʿaduwwan.
Noun (concrete), nominative, muḍāf to 2nd person masculine plural pronoun -kum; subject of nominal sentence
Adjective comparative/superlative (af'alu pattern), nominative; predicate of nominal sentence; elative form

noun, feminine singular, genitive (governed by fī via coordination with samāwāt), with definite article al-

noun, masculine singular, genitive (governed by 'alā), indefinite with tanwīn

Gerund (maṣdar), masculine singular, accusative (direct object of yakhāfūna), with 3rd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -hu referring to God
Noun abstract, masculine singular, accusative (ism of inna), in construct state (iḍāfa) with rabbika; second occurrence of '-dh-b root in this ayah
Noun, masculine singular, genitive (second term of iḍāfa with ʿadhāba), with 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka; addresses the Prophet or the reader directly
Passive participle (ism mafʿūl), masculine singular, accusative (predicate of kāna); from Form I ḥadhira (to be cautious/wary); unique Quranic occurrence of this specific form
Indefinite feminine noun, genitive case (governed by min). From root q-r-y: to gather, to host, to collect. The tanwīn with kasrah marks genitive under min.

Active participle (NOUN_ACTIVE_PART), Form IV (ahlaka), masculine plural construct form + attached feminine pronoun -hā referring to qaryah. Pattern: mu-f'il-ūna → mu-f'il-ū (construct). Predicate of naḥnu.
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), genitive case in iḍāfah with al-qiyāmah. Governed by qabla. From root y-w-m: a day, a period of time, an era.
Proper noun (NOUN_PROP), genitive case in iḍāfah with yawm. From root q-w-m: to stand, to rise, to be established. Pattern: qiyāmah (fi'ālah) = the act of standing/rising.

Active participle (NOUN_ACTIVE_PART), Form II (ʿaddhaba), masculine plural construct + attached -hā. Parallel structure to muhlikūhā. Predicate of naḥnu (shared). Pattern: mu-fa''il-ūna → mu-fa''il-ū (construct).
Noun abstract (NOUN_ABSTRACT), indefinite accusative. Functions as maf'ūl muṭlaq (cognate accusative) — reinforcing the verb/participle mu'adhdhibūhā with its own nominal form. Same root as word 12.
Qualitative adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), indefinite accusative, modifying 'adhāban. From root sh-d-d: to be strong, firm, intense, violent.

Definite noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive case governed by fī. The definite article al- marks a specific, known Book — the cosmic register, the preserved tablet (al-lawḥ al-maḥfūẓ), or the totality of divine decree.

Passive participle (NOUN_PASSIVE_PART), indefinite accusative, functioning as predicate of kāna (complement). From root s-ṭ-r: to write in lines, to compose, to rule lines. Pattern: maf'ūl (passive participle of Form I).
NOUN_ABSTRACT — definite noun, genitive (majrūr by bi), plural of āya; refers to cosmic/miraculous signs demanded by disbelievers

NOUN_CONCRETE — definite noun with article al-, genitive case (jarr by bi-); from '-n-s meaning human beings, people, mankind
GERUND — verbal noun (maṣdar) from r-'-y, definite with al-; in accusative as 1st object of ja'alnā; ru'yā = vision, seeing, dream-vision, visual experience
GERUND — verbal noun (maṣdar), indefinite, accusative as 2nd object of ja'alnā (complement); fitna = trial, test, temptation, sedition, affliction

NOUN_CONCRETE — definite noun with article al-, accusative as 2nd coordinated object of ja'alnā (parallel to ru'yā); shajara = tree, plant
NOUN_PASSIVE_PART — passive participle, definite with article, accusative as adjective to al-shajarata; from l-'-n: cursed, expelled from divine mercy
NOUN_CONCRETE — proper noun/noun, definite with article, genitive by fī; from q-r-' meaning to recite, to read, to gather; al-Qur'ān = the Recitation, the Reading
GERUND — verbal noun (maṣdar), indefinite, accusative as tamyīz (specification of the increase); ṭughyān = transgression, overstepping bounds, insolence, flooding

NOUN_CONCRETE, definite plural, genitive case (governed by لِ); broken plural of مَلَك (malak)

NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN, proper noun, accusative case (exception from sajadū); the sole being who refused
NOUN_CONCRETE, indefinite accusative (ḥāl or tamyīz); specifies the material of creation
PREP + 1st person singular pronoun suffix; preposition عَلَى governing the 1st person pronoun; indicates superiority/preference — "above me" in rank

Noun, masculine singular, nominative (mubtada'/subject), with 2nd person masculine plural possessive pronoun -kum
Noun, masculine (or feminine) singular or plural (same form), accusative (direct object of yuzjī), with definite article
Noun, masculine singular, genitive (majrūr by fī), with definite article
Verbal noun (maṣdar/gerund), masculine singular, genitive (majrūr by min), with 3rd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -hī, in iḍāfa
Adjective of intensive/habitual pattern (fa'īl), masculine singular accusative indefinite (predicate of kāna)
GERUND with definite article, nominative case (subject of massa), agentive role
NOUN_CONCRETE, definite, genitive case (governed by fi), prepositional object
NOUN_CONCRETE, definite, genitive case (governed by ila), prepositional object
NOUN_CONCRETE, definite, nominative (subject of kāna), occupying the copula subject position
ADJ_INTENS, indefinite accusative (predicate of kāna), fa'ūl pattern expressing habitual/intensive quality

Noun (masculine singular) in the accusative (manṣūb) as the direct object of yakhsifa -- the thing caused to sink. From j-n-b: side, flank, lateral aspect. The accusative indicates it is the land-side that is caused to cave in.
Definite noun (masculine singular) in the genitive (majrūr) as the second term of an iḍāfa (genitive construction) with jānib. From b-r-r: dry land (as opposed to sea), also righteousness/piety.

Active participle (fāʿil pattern) in the accusative as the direct object of yursila. From h-s-b: to pelt with small stones (ḥaṣab); ḥāṣib = a wind that hurls stones/gravel, or the stones themselves. Indefinite (tanwīn) emphasizing unspecified, fearsome force.

Noun (faʿīl pattern) in the accusative as the direct object of tajidū. Indefinite (tanwīn). From w-k-l: to entrust, to rely upon. A wakīl is one entrusted with affairs, an advocate, guardian, proxy, or trustee who acts on another's behalf.
Noun, indefinite accusative (ḥāl or adverbial accusative of time), from t-'-r. Extremely rare root in the Quran — only 2 occurrences total.
Adjective, feminine singular indefinite accusative, comparative/other form (af'al pattern, feminine fu'lā). Modifies tāratan — "another time."
Active participle (fā'il pattern), indefinite accusative, from q-s-f: "to break, to shatter, to snap." This is the ONLY occurrence of this root in the entire Quran — a true hapax legomenon.

Noun, definite singular genitive (governed by min), from r-w-ḥ. The singular rīḥ (vs plural riyāḥ) in the Quran tends to appear in contexts of punishment and destruction, while the plural riyāḥ tends toward mercy.

Intensive adjective (fa'īl pattern), indefinite accusative, from t-b-': "to follow, to pursue." The fa'īl pattern intensifies: not merely one who follows, but one who relentlessly pursues. This specific form (tabī' as ADJ_INTENS) occurs ONLY here in the entire Quran.

Noun, masculine plural construct (muḍāf to ءَادَمَ). Construct state of بَنُون. Direct object of كَرَّمْنَا. b-n-y denotes structural building/constructing — "sons" as those built/constructed from a progenitor.

Proper noun, foreign (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN), genitive (muḍāf ilayhi in construct with بَنِي). Declined as diptote (mamūʿ min aṣ-ṣarf) — takes fatḥa for genitive. The root '-d-m in Arabic connects to surface/skin (adīm), earth/soil (adama), and brownness/darkness (udma).

Noun, masculine singular, definite (al-), genitive (after fī). From b-r-r which encompasses both "land/dry ground" (as opposed to sea) and "righteousness/piety" (birr). The dual semantic field is structurally present.
Noun, masculine singular, definite (al-), genitive (coordinated with ٱلْبَرِّ after فِى). b-h-r denotes vastness, depth, a body of water so wide one cannot see its edges.

Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT used substantively), feminine plural, definite (al-), genitive (after مِنَ). From t-y-b: purity, pleasantness, wholesomeness. The definite article al- makes it generic — all good things.

Adjective used as noun (qualitative adjective, PREP_OBJ), masculine singular, indefinite, genitive (after عَلَىٰ). The tanwīn with kasra indicates indefiniteness — "many" (not "all" or "most"). This is a crucial semantic choice: kathīr, not kull or akbar.

Verbal noun (maṣdar/GERUND), Form II pattern (taf'īl), masculine singular, indefinite, accusative. Functions as مفعول مطلق (cognate accusative) reinforcing فَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ — "We preferred them... a preferring." Same root f-d-l as the verb. Emphatic confirmation.
Accusative noun functioning as direct object of nad'ū. Construct state (muḍāf) governing unāsin in genitive. Universal quantifier.
Indefinite genitive noun (majrūr by iḍāfa with kull). The form unās is a diminutive or variant collective of nās/insān, specifically designating groups or communities of people.
Genitive noun (governed by بِ) + 3rd person masculine plural possessive pronoun -him; imām = that which is followed: leader, record, way, paradigm
Accusative noun (maf'ūl thānī retained in passive construction) + possessive pronoun -hū (3rd masc. sing., referring back to man). Definite through iḍāfa with pronoun.
Genitive noun (governed by بِ) + 3rd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -hī; yamīn as physical and symbolic locus of strength, oath, and blessing

Accusative noun (direct object of yaqra'ūna) + possessive pronoun -hum (3rd masc. plural). Note the pronoun shift: kitābahū (his, singular) in the conditional becomes kitābahum (their, plural) in the consequence — matching the man → ulā'ika shift.

Accusative indefinite noun — tamyīz (accusative of specification) or maf'ūl muṭlaq (cognate accusative), quantifying the extent of the negated wronging. Specifies the absolute minimum threshold: not even a thread's worth.
Adjective of quality (ṣifa mushabbaha) on the pattern af'al; here functioning as predicate of kāna (khabr kāna); first occurrence in this ayah
Active participle (feminine, genitive) from '-kh-r used as a noun; governed by fī; refers to the afterlife/final state; definite with al-
Adjective of quality (ṣifa mushabbaha) on the pattern af'al; second occurrence in this ayah; here functioning as predicate (khabar) of the nominal sentence huwa...a'mā
Comparative adjective (af'al al-tafḍīl) from d-l-l; coordinated with a'mā as second predicate of the apodosis; governs sabīlā as tamyīz
Abstract noun, accusative singular indefinite (tanwīn); functions as tamyīz (accusative of specification) — specifying the domain of the comparative aḍallu; "more astray with respect to path"
Abstract noun in accusative (object of taftariya); attached pronoun -hū refers back to alladhī awḥaynā (the revelation); "something other/different from it"
Adjective of quality in accusative, indefinite; second object of ittakhadhūka (maf'ūl bihi thānī); pattern fa'īl from root kh-l-l
indefinite noun, accusative (cognate/adverbial accusative — mafʿūl muṭlaq or tamyīz)
qualitative adjective, indefinite accusative, modifying shayʾan
Noun (gerund/maṣdar) in the accusative as direct object of adhaqnāka. First element of a construct chain (iḍāfa): ḍiʿfa l-ḥayāti. Denotes doubling, multiplication, or compounding.

Definite noun (gerund/verbal noun) in the genitive case as second element of the construct chain ḍiʿfa l-ḥayāti. The definite article al- marks it as a known/specific life -- this-worldly life or life in general.
Noun (gerund) in the accusative, second direct object of adhaqnāka coordinated with the first ḍiʿf via wa. Second element of construct chain: ḍiʿfa l-mamāti.

Mīm-prefixed verbal noun (maṣdar mīmī / gerund_meem) in the genitive case, second element of iḍāfa chain ḍiʿfa l-mamāti. The mīm-maṣdar form mamāt denotes the process or state of dying, contrasting with mawt (the event of death).

Intensive adjective (ṣīghatu l-mubālagha, faʿīl pattern) in the accusative as direct object of tajidu. Indefinite with tanwīn, functioning in the scope of negation (lā tajidu naṣīran = you will not find ANY helper). The faʿīl pattern denotes one who characteristically performs the action -- a professional or habitual helper.
Definite noun, genitive case (majrūr) governed by mina. The definite article al- can indicate a specific land (the land of Mecca/the addressee's territory) or the earth generically.

Noun in the accusative functioning as a temporal/locative adverb (ẓarf zamān) + 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun -ka. From the root kh-l-f (to come after, to succeed, to differ, to oppose). Can be read as temporal (after your departure) or oppositional (in contradiction/opposition to you).

Indefinite adjective in the accusative, functioning as a ṣifa for a deleted maṣdar (labathan qalīlan = a brief remaining) or as a ḥāl/tamyīz. From the root q-l-l (to be few, to be little, to be scarce).
Accusative indefinite noun (maf'ul mutlaq or accusative of specification), feminine singular from root s-n-n; cognate to the verb sanna (to establish a way/track)
Genitive plural noun (jam' taksir), masculine, from root r-s-l; with first person plural possessive pronoun suffix -nā; governed by preposition min
Genitive feminine singular noun sunnah (governed by لِ) in construct (muḍāf) with attached 1st person plural possessive pronoun -nā; signals divine possession

Accusative indefinite gerund (masdar), Form II taf'il pattern, from root h-w-l; functions as direct object of tajidu; the tanwin (-an) on accusative emphasizes indefiniteness — any alteration whatsoever
Definite accusative noun (gerund), direct object of aqimi; the alif-lām is for generic reference (the institution of prayer) or for specific well-known prayer
Genitive verbal noun (gerund / maṣdar) of dalaka, governed by لِ; hapax legomenon in the Quran, only occurrence of root d-l-k
Definite genitive noun, muḍāf ilayh (possessor) in the iḍāfa construction dulūki sh-shamsi
Genitive noun (abstract), object of preposition ilā; iḍāfa with al-layl; rare root -- only 4 Quranic occurrences total
Definite genitive noun (abstract), muḍāf ilayh in ghasaqi l-layli construction; 86 total Quranic occurrences
Accusative noun (concrete), either coordinated with aṣ-ṣalāta as second object of aqimi, or adverbial accusative; first of two occurrences in this ayah; iḍāfa with al-fajr
Definite genitive noun (abstract), muḍāf ilayh in qurʾāna l-fajri; first of two occurrences in the ayah
Accusative noun (concrete), subject of inna (inna governs accusative); second occurrence in this ayah; iḍāfa with al-fajr; identical form to word 9 but now in inna-clause
Definite genitive noun (abstract), muḍāf ilayh; second occurrence, completing the repeated phrase qurʾāna l-fajri
Passive participle (mafʿūl pattern), accusative indefinite; predicate of kāna; Form I passive: "something witnessed" -- that which has witnesses present or attending
noun, definite (al-), genitive (after مِن), abstract temporal noun
noun, indefinite, accusative (ḥāl or mafʿūl li-ajlihi — state or purpose), active participle pattern fāʿilah used as abstract noun
noun, definite by iḍāfah (construct with pronoun كَ), nominative (subject of يَبْعَثَ), with 2ms possessive pronoun
mīm-prefixed verbal noun (مَفْعَل pattern = noun of place/time from q-w-m), indefinite, accusative (either second object of yabʿatha or adverbial of state/goal)
passive participle (mafʿūl pattern from ḥamida), indefinite, accusative (adjective modifying maqāman), Form I passive
Noun in vocative (munādā), 1st person singular possessive suffix -ī (yāʾ al-mutakallim elided in pause form). From rabb (lord, master, sustainer). Genitive/vocative construction.
Noun of place/time (ism al-makān) or verbal noun (maṣdar mīmī), Form IV pattern muf'al. Accusative as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq) to adkhilnī. Governs ṣidqin in genitive construct (iḍāfa).
Gerund/verbal noun (maṣdar), indefinite genitive (majrūr) as second element of iḍāfa with mudkhala. Qualifies the manner or character of the entering.
Noun of place/time (ism al-makān) or verbal noun (maṣdar mīmī), Form IV pattern muf'al. Accusative as cognate accusative (mafʿūl muṭlaq) to akhrijnī. Governs ṣidqin in genitive construct (iḍāfa).
Gerund/verbal noun (maṣdar), indefinite genitive (majrūr) as second element of iḍāfa with mukhraja. Second occurrence in the ayah, qualifying the exiting.

Noun of place (ẓarf makān) meaning 'nearness, presence, beside-ness' with 2nd person masculine singular attached pronoun -ka. Object of preposition min. Indicates intimate divine proximity as the source.
Abstract noun (maṣdar/ism maʿnā), accusative indefinite as direct object of ijʿal. Takes naṣīran as attributive adjective. From s-l-ṭ: to overpower, to have authority over.

Intensive adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha/ism mubālagha, pattern faʿīl), accusative indefinite. Functions as attributive adjective (naʿt) to sulṭānan, or as second accusative object of ijʿal (a sulṭān that is itself a naṣīr).
Definite noun/gerund (GERUND), nominative (marfūʿ), agent (fāʿil) of jāʾa; definite article al- marks it as THE ḥaqq, not a ḥaqq
Active participle (NOUN_ACTIVE_PART), definite, nominative (marfūʿ), agent (fāʿil) of zahaqa; from b-ṭ-l "to be void/null"
Active participle (NOUN_ACTIVE_PART), definite, accusative (manṣūb) under inna as subject of kāna clause; same root as word 7
Intensive adjective (ADJ_QUALIT), indefinite, accusative (manṣūb) as predicate (khabar) of kāna; faʿūl pattern (intensive/habitual)
definite noun, genitive (majrūr by min), concrete noun
indefinite nominative noun (gerund/maṣdar), predicate of nominal clause (khabar)
indefinite nominative noun (gerund/maṣdar), coordinated predicate (khabar maʿṭūf)
Definite article ال (assimilated to لِ) + active participle muʾmin (Form IV ʾāmana), masculine plural, genitive (majrūr) governed by لِ; the beneficiary
definite active participle, masculine plural, accusative (manṣūb, object of yazīdu)
indefinite accusative noun (gerund/maṣdar), tamyīz (specification) or second object of yazīdu
definite noun, genitive (governed by ʿalā), generic reference to humanity
Active-participle noun jānib in genitive (governed by بِ) with attached 3ms pronoun هِۦ; NOUN_ABSTRACT — "his side"
definite noun (gerund), nominative (subject of massahu), agentive role
intensive adjective (faʿūl pattern), indefinite accusative (predicate of kāna)
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), nominative with tanwīn, functioning as subject of ya'malu; universal quantifier
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), genitive after 'alā, with 3ms pronoun suffix -hī; active participle pattern fā'ila
Noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), nominative, subject of a'lamu; with 2mp pronoun suffix -kum
Comparative/superlative adjective (ADJ_COMP, af'alu pattern), predicative position; elative form
Comparative/superlative adjective (ADJ_COMP, af'alu pattern), predicative; elative form
Noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), accusative as tamyīz (specification of the domain of ahdā)
NOUN - definite abstract noun, genitive case (majrūr by 'an), al-rūḥ
NOUN - definite abstract noun, nominative case (mubtada' - subject of nominal sentence)
GERUND - verbal noun (maṣdar) of Form I, genitive case (majrūr by min), in iḍāfa with rabbī
NOUN - definite by iḍāfa with 1s pronoun suffix -ī (yā' al-mutakallim), genitive (muḍāf ilayhi)
GERUND - verbal noun (maṣdar), definite with al-, genitive (majrūr by min)
ADJ_QUALIT - qualitative adjective, accusative indefinite (manṣūb tanwīn), exception clause complement

Noun, masculine singular, indefinite accusative (naṣb). Root w-k-l. Pattern fa'īl. Functions as the object of tajidu — the thing sought but not found. The tanwīn accusative marks it as the direct object.
Indefinite accusative gerund (maṣdar); accusative as mustathnā (excepted noun) governed by illā; the tanwīn marks indefiniteness — a mercy (unspecified in scope), not the mercy
Genitive noun (majrūr by min); construct state (muḍāf) with second-person singular possessive suffix -ka; from r-b-b: the one who sustains, nourishes, brings to maturity

Accusative noun (ism inna — subject of inna in the accusative); construct state (muḍāf) with third-person masculine singular possessive suffix -hū referring to rabb; from f-ḍ-l: what remains over and above, surplus, bounty

Indefinite accusative qualitative adjective (ṣifa); accusative as predicate of kāna (khabar kāna); from k-b-r: to be great in size, age, importance; tanwīn marks indefiniteness — an unquantified greatness
Definite noun, nominative (marfūʿ) as subject (fāʿil) of ijtamaʿat. Collective noun denoting the human species as a whole. Distinguished from al-insān (individual human) by its collective force.
Definite noun, nominative (marfūʿ) as conjoined subject (maʿṭūf) with al-insu. Collective noun denoting the jinn species. From j-n-n = to conceal, to cover, to hide.
Noun mithl in genitive (majrūr, governed by بِ); construct head — governs hādhā l-qurʾāni via iḍāfa; pattern fiʿl
Definite noun, genitive (majrūr) as apposition to hādhā (or second term of iḍāfa chain: mithli hādhā l-qurʾāni). From q-r-' = to read, to recite, to gather, to compile.

Noun mithl in genitive (governed by بِ) + 3rd person masculine singular pronoun -hi (referring back to al-qurʾān); pronominal suffix replaces the demonstrative + noun chain of the parallel bi-mithli phrase
Noun baʿḍ (part, some) + 3rd person masculine plural pronoun -hum. Nominative (marfūʿ) as subject (ism kāna). Refers back to al-ins wa-l-jinn collectively.
Indefinite noun in genitive (governed by لِ); singular form used distributively to mean "some/others" — completes the reciprocal pair baʿḍuhum li-baʿḍin

Intensive adjective (ṣifat mushabbaha / mubālagha form faʿīl), accusative (manṣūb) as predicate of kāna (khabar kāna). Indefinite with tanwīn. From z-h-r = back, support, manifest, appear. ẓahīr = one who provides backing/support (from one's back/ẓahr).
Definite noun, genitive case (governed by li-). From root '-n-s. Used here to designate humanity collectively as the beneficiaries of divine communication.
Definite noun, genitive case (governed by fī through hādhā). From root q-r-ʾ. The definite article + proper name creates unique reference. Appositive to hādhā.
Noun of totality in genitive case (governed by min), functioning as first term of iḍāfa (construct state) with mathalin. Establishes universal scope: not some kinds of similitude but every kind.
Indefinite noun, genitive singular (second term of iḍāfa with kulli). The indefinite form with tanwin under kull gives unrestricted scope: any and every type of mathal without limitation.
Comparative/superlative adjective (ism tafḍīl), nominative as subject (fāʿil) of abā. From root k-th-r. First term of iḍāfa with al-nāsi. Marks the majority -- not all, but most.
Definite noun, genitive singular (second term of iḍāfa with aktharu). Second occurrence in the ayah (see word 5). Here specifies the population whose majority refused.

Intensive adjective (ṣīghat mubālagha, pattern fuʿūl) in accusative as mustaṯnā (exception) or as ḥāl (state). From root k-f-r. The intensive pattern fuʿūl signals not mere disbelief but extreme, persistent covering/denial.

Definite concrete noun, genitive case (majrūr, governed by min). Refers to the ground/earth as physical terrain — the surface from which a spring must emerge. The definite article al- makes it specific: this earth, the ground beneath their feet.

Concrete noun, accusative indefinite (object of tafjura). Pattern yaf'ūl — an instrument/place noun: "a thing that springs forth / a gushing place." From n-b-' meaning to spring forth, to emerge, to gush out. The indefinite form (no al-) leaves the spring unspecified — just "a spring," any spring.
Feminine singular indefinite nominative, subject of takūna (copulative predicate construction with laka)
Collective noun genitive indefinite, object of preposition min
Masculine singular genitive indefinite (collective noun), conjoined to nakhīl via wa
Masculine plural accusative definite (broken plural of nahr), direct object of tufajjira
Adverbial accusative of place (ẓarf makān), with 3rd feminine singular pronoun referring to jannah
Cognate accusative (maf'ūl muṭlaq) of tufajjira, gerund Form II; emphatic intensification
definite noun, accusative singular (object of تُسْقِطَ); from s-m-w — that which is high/elevated
indefinite noun, accusative (circumstantial accusative — ḥāl, describing the manner of the sky's falling); from k-s-f = eclipse, darken, break into pieces
Definite proper noun (the divine name) in genitive case (governed by بِ); the comprehensive designation of the worshipped God
definite noun, genitive (coordinated with الله after بِ); plural of مَلَك (malak); from m-l-k = possession, sovereignty, control
indefinite noun, accusative (circumstantial — ḥāl, describing the manner of bringing); from q-b-l = to face, to come forward, to accept, to guarantee
Noun, indefinite nominative singular; subject of yakūna (copulative verb); tanwin marks indefiniteness
Noun, indefinite genitive singular (governed by min); quadriliteral root
Noun, definite genitive singular (governed by fī); from s-m-w = to be high, elevated
Gerund (maṣdar) of raqiya, genitive (governed by li-), with 2ms possessive pronoun ـكَ; nominalization of the act of ascending
Noun, indefinite accusative singular; direct object of tunazzila; tanwin marks indefiniteness
Gerund (maṣdar) in accusative, functioning as a cognate object (maf'ūl muṭlaq); always in construct (iḍāfa) — subḥāna + genitive noun
Noun, definite genitive singular (in construct with subḥāna) + 1st singular possessive pronoun يِ; the -ī suffix indicates intimate personal relationship
Noun, indefinite accusative singular; predicate of kuntu (copulative); tanwin marks indefiniteness
Noun, indefinite accusative singular; second predicate of kuntu (or adjective/apposition to basharan); tanwin marks indefiniteness
Definite noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), accusative case (direct object of مَنَعَ), with definite article ال.
Verbal noun / maṣdar (GERUND), definite with ال, nominative (subject of جَآءَ). From root h-d-y = to guide, to walk ahead showing the way.
Proper noun (NOUN_PROP), nominative case (subject of بَعَثَ). The divine name.
Indefinite noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), accusative case (object of بَعَثَ). First of two accusatives in apposition: بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا.

Indefinite noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), accusative case — apposition (badal or 'aṭf bayān) to بَشَرًا, specifying the role: a human who is also a messenger. Alternatively, second accusative complement: "a human [in the capacity of] a messenger."
Noun, definite genitive singular (governed by fī); concrete noun denoting the terrestrial realm
Noun, indefinite nominative plural (subject of kāna); broken plural of malak; tanwin marks indefiniteness — any angels, not specific ones
Active participle, accusative masculine plural; ḥāl (second circumstantial description); Form I participle of quadriliteral root; accusative because it describes the state of the subject of yamshūna
Noun, definite genitive singular (governed by min); concrete noun denoting the celestial realm — the elevated domain
Noun, indefinite accusative singular (direct object of nazzalnā); singular of malā'ika; tanwin marks indefiniteness
Noun, indefinite accusative singular; appositive (badal) or second object describing malakan — the angel would function AS messenger; tanwin marks indefiniteness
Proper noun (the divine name), genitive case in form (governed by bāʾ zāʾida) but functioning as syntactic subject of kafā
Noun (faʿīl pattern), indefinite accusative singular; functions as tamyīz (accusative of specification) — specifying in what capacity God suffices
Noun (ẓarf makān = adverb of place), genitive construct with yāʾ mutakallim (1cs possessive pronoun); establishes first spatial boundary of testimony
Plural noun ʿibād (plural of ʿabd), genitive case (governed by بِ), with attached 3ms possessive pronoun -hi referring to Allāh
Adjective (faʿīl pattern, intensive), indefinite accusative singular; functions as V_COP_PRED (predicate of kāna); describes quality of divine knowledge
Adjective (faʿīl pattern, intensive), indefinite accusative singular; second V_COP_PRED of kāna; completes the dual-attribute formula
Proper noun; nominative (AGNT) — subject of yahdi; the lām carries assimilation (shamsī)
Active participle Form VIII (muftaʿil pattern); definite with al-; predicate (khabar) of nominal sentence; apocopated form (standard Hafs drops final yāʾ at pause)
Noun, broken plural of walī; accusative (object of tajida); indefinite — any protectors at all
Noun (adverb of place); genitive governed by min; with attached pronoun -hi (3ms, referring to God); dūn = below, besides, apart from
Noun; genitive (second term of iḍāfa with yawm); definite; from qiyām (standing) + tāʾ marbūṭa (intensifying)
Noun; broken plural of wajh; genitive (governed by ʿalā); with attached pronoun -him (3mp); faces = the seat of identity and honor
Adjective; broken plural of aʿmā; accusative (ḥāl — circumstantial state describing their condition during gathering); indefinite
Adjective; broken plural of abkam; accusative (ḥāl, parallel to ʿumyan); indefinite
Adjective; accusative plural (ḥāl, parallel to ʿumyan and bukman); from aṣamm (deaf); geminated root ṣ-m-m
Noun of place/time (mafʿal pattern); nominative (subject/mubtadaʾ); with attached pronoun -hum; maʾwā = place of sheltering
Compound temporal particle (kull + mā); adverb of time; introduces iterative temporal clause — whenever/every time
Noun; accusative (second object of zidnāhum — specifying what is increased); indefinite with tanwīn; from saʿara: to kindle
Gerund (maṣdar), nominative as predicate of dhālika; attached pronoun -hum (3rd masculine plural) marks those receiving recompense
Noun abstract, feminine plural genitive (governed by bi); attached pronoun -nā (1st plural majestic) marks divine ownership
Noun concrete, accusative indefinite; predicate of kunnā (copulative complement); plural of 'aẓm (bone)

Passive participle (ism maf'ūl), masculine plural nominative; predicate of inna (via lām); implies an unstated agent (God) who performs the raising

Definite concrete noun, nominative case (subject/ism of kāna). The definite article al- makes it generic — "the human being as a species" not "a particular person." The term is deliberately inclusive of all humanity.

Intensive adjective (ṣīghat mubālagha) on the fa'ūl pattern, accusative indefinite (predicate/khabar of kāna). The fa'ūl pattern indicates an extreme, enduring degree of the quality — not occasionally stingy but constitutively, intensely restrictive.

Proper noun, foreign origin (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN). Accusative (first object of ātaynā). Indeclinable due to foreign origin, but functions as mafʿūl bihi (direct object, recipient of the giving). Appears 136 times in the Quran as a central prophetic figure.

Cardinal numeral, accusative (second object of ātaynā, in construct state with āyātin). Arabic numerals 3-10 take the opposite gender of the counted noun -- tisʿa (without tāʾ marbūṭa) counts feminine āyātin. The number nine appears 7 times in the Quran.

Noun, feminine plural, genitive (muḍāf ilayhi in construct with tisʿa). Tanwīn-kasra indicates indefinite genitive. From '-y-y: sign, marker, evidence, verse, miracle. One of the Quran's most polyvalent terms. 382 NOUN_ABSTRACT occurrences with HIGH syntactic diversity (14 roles).

Adjective (ṣifa), feminine plural, genitive, agreeing with āyātin in case, gender, and number. Active participle pattern faʿʿilāt from Form I bayyana, or intensive adjective pattern. Indicates the signs are inherently clear -- they carry their own evidence.

Noun, masculine plural, accusative (object of sʾal -- those being asked). Construct state (muḍāf) governing isrāʾīla. From b-n-y: to build, to construct; ibn (son) as what a man builds. The plural banūna/banīna in construct becomes banī.

Proper noun, foreign origin (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN). Genitive (muḍāf ilayhi, governed by banī). Indeclinable. Refers to the patriarch Yaʿqūb (Jacob) and by extension his descendants. 43 Quranic occurrences, almost always in the construct banī isrāʾīla. The root s-r-y-l assigned by MASAQ relates to sarābīl (garments), but isrāʾīl is etymologically Hebrew, not derived from an Arabic root.

Proper noun, foreign origin (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN). Nominative (subject of qāla, delayed after the verb). From Egyptian per-ʿaa (great house), entering Arabic as the archetypal title of tyranny. The Arabic ear may hear echoes of f-r-ʿ (branch, height, excess). 74 Quranic occurrences.
Proper noun (NOUN_PROP_FOREIGN), vocative case (munādā). The second mention of Moses in this ayah -- first as recipient of signs (ātaynā mūsā), now as target of Pharaoh's accusation. Indeclinable.

Passive participle (mafʿūl pattern: masḥūr), masculine singular, accusative (second object of ẓanna, predicate complement describing the state attributed to Moses). Proper noun, foreign (non-Arabic), nominative case as vocative (munādā ʿalam mufrad). The name is mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf (diptote, no tanwīn) due to being foreign and proper. Refers to the Egyptian ruler confronting Musa.

Cardinal number in the accusative case (object of izdādū — mafʿūl bihi, or accusative of specification — tamyīz). The tanwīn leaves the counted noun unspecified: "nine" of what? This grammatical openness is deliberate.

Comparative/superlative adjective (ADJ_COMP, afʿalu pattern), functioning as predicate (khabar) of the mubtadaʾ Allāh. Can be read as elative (most knowing — absolute superlative) or comparative (more knowing than anyone else). Diptote: no tanwīn, no kasra.

Verbal noun / maṣdar (GERUND), nominative case — delayed subject (mubtadaʾ muʾakhkhar) of the predicate lahu. In construct (iḍāfa) with al-samāwāti: "the ghayb OF the heavens." The ghayb here is not an attribute but a domain — the totality of hidden reality.

Feminine plural noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive case (mudāf ilayhi in construct with ghaybu). Definite with al-. The samāwāt are the totality of what is above — paired with al-arḍ to form a merism encompassing all of creation.
Feminine singular noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive case (conjoined with al-samāwāti via wa in construct with ghaybu). Definite with al-. The arḍ is the counterpart to samāwāt in the merism.

Abstract noun (NOUN_ABSTRACT), genitive case (governed by min), with 3rd person masculine singular pronoun -hi referring to Allāh. dūn functions as a semi-preposition meaning "below, beneath, short of, other than." min dūnihi = "from below Him / apart from Him."

Masculine singular noun (NOUN_CONCRETE), genitive case (governed by min al-zāʾida, and by its position in the negated existential construction). Indefinite (tanwīn). A waliyy is one who is close (waliya = to be near) and who therefore has authority, guardianship, or protective power.

Verbal noun / maṣdar (GERUND), genitive case (governed by fī), with 3rd person masculine singular pronoun -hi referring to Allāh. In construct: "His ḥukm." ḥukm spans judgment, governance, legislation, and sovereign decree — it is the executive dimension of divine authority.

Numerical noun (NOUN_NUM), accusative case (mafʿūl bihi — direct object of yushriku). Indefinite with tanwīn. aḥad under negation = "not anyone, not a single one" — universal denial. No created entity whatsoever is admitted into divine governance.
Masculine singular noun in genitive case (governed by min), first member of an iḍāfa construction with rabbika (kitābi rabbika = "the book of your lord"). Definite by virtue of iḍāfa.
Masculine singular noun in genitive case (mudāf ilayhi in kitābi rabbika), with 2nd person masculine singular possessive pronoun suffix -ka. Definite by virtue of the pronoun attachment.

Form II active participle (mufaʿʿil pattern), masculine singular in accusative case (governed by lā li-nafy al-jins — ism lā). The fatḥa ending is from categorical negation, not from being an object. The li-phrase (li-kalimātihi) completes its meaning: "changer of His words."

Feminine plural noun in genitive case (governed by li-), with 3rd person masculine singular pronoun suffix -hi (referring to rabb). Definite by virtue of the pronoun. The plural kalimāt (sound feminine plural) indicates multiple discrete units of divine speech.

Masculine singular noun in genitive case (governed by min), with 3rd person masculine singular pronoun suffix -hi (referring to rabb/Allāh). Functions as a ẓarf (adverb of place) meaning "in the space below/apart from." The pronoun references God, making dūnihi = "in the domain that is not God."

Form VIII verbal noun / noun of place (muftaʿal pattern), accusative indefinite (object of tajida). From l-ḥ-d: to deviate, to incline laterally, to dig a lateral niche. The tanwīn indicates indefiniteness: "any refuge whatsoever." The root has only 6 Quranic occurrences total (uncommon).
Accusative singular noun (manṣūb) functioning as direct object (mafʿūl bihi) of iṣbir. Possessive pronoun -ka (your). The nafs is the thing being restrained.
Accusative noun (manṣūb) functioning as direct object of yadʿūna. 3rd person masculine plural possessive -hum.
Definite genitive noun (majrūr) governed by bi. Time-noun referring to the morning/dawn period.
Definite genitive noun (majrūr) coordinated with al-ghadāti. Time-noun referring to the evening period.
Accusative noun (manṣūb) functioning as direct object of yurīdūna. 3rd person masculine singular possessive -hu referring to rabb.
Nominative dual noun (marfūʿ) functioning as subject (fāʿil) of taʿdu. 2nd person masculine singular possessive -ka. Dual form emphasizes both eyes acting together.
Accusative noun (manṣūb) functioning as direct object of turīdu. First element of an iḍāfa chain: zīnata l-ḥayāti d-dunyā.
Definite genitive noun (majrūr) as second element of iḍāfa chain. Modified by al-dunyā.
Definite genitive adjective (ṣifa) modifying al-ḥayāt. Feminine superlative/elative form of danā (to be near/low).
Accusative noun (manṣūb) functioning as direct object of aghfalnā. 3rd person masculine singular possessive -hu.
Genitive gerund (maṣdar majrūr) governed by ʿan. 1st person plural possessive -nā (divine "Our"). Can mean "remembering Us" (subjective genitive) or "Our reminder/mention" (objective genitive).
Accusative gerund (maṣdar manṣūb) functioning as direct object of ittabaʿa. 3rd person masculine singular possessive -hu.
Nominative noun (marfūʿ) functioning as subject (ism kāna). 3rd person masculine singular possessive -hu.
Accusative indefinite noun (manṣūb) functioning as predicate of kāna (khabar kāna). Describes the state of the affair.

Gerund (maṣdar), accusative as direct object of nuḍīʿu. Construct state (iḍāfa) with man — "the reward of whoever."

Elative/comparative adjective (afʿal pattern) functioning as perfect verb (Form IV PV: aḥsana = he did well/beautifully). The afʿal form is ambiguous: can be (a) Form IV PV "he made good/beautiful" or (b) comparative adjective "better/best." Context supports PV reading with ʿamalan as tamyīz.
Gerund (maṣdar), accusative as tamyīz (specification) for aḥsana: "excelled in respect of deed." Second occurrence of root '-m-l in this ayah (first: ʿamilū, word 5).

Definite nominative noun, sound masculine plural of ibn. Co-subject with al-mālu. The masculine plural form banūna can encompass offspring generically, though formally masculine. Generic definite article.

Indefinite nominative noun in construct state (iḍāfa) with al-ḥayāti. Predicate of the nominal sentence whose subjects are al-mālu wa-l-banūna. The construct chain zīnatu l-ḥayāti makes it definite by association.
Definite genitive noun, first member of the iḍāfa chain governed by zīnatu. Genitive case by virtue of construct state.
Definite nominative adjective (feminine superlative form of adnā) functioning as a restrictive adjective to al-ḥayāti. Genitive by agreement with al-ḥayāti in the construct chain.

Definite nominative feminine plural active participle of baqiya. Subject of the second nominal sentence. The active participial form emphasizes ongoing, present-tense endurance — these things ARE enduring, not "were" or "will be."

Definite nominative feminine plural active participle of ṣalaḥa. Restrictive adjective to al-bāqiyātu, further defining the subject. Active participial form: these things ARE correcting/sound, not just "good."
Indefinite nominative comparative adjective (afu'al pattern → khayrun). Predicate of the nominal sentence with al-bāqiyātu ṣ-ṣāliḥātu as subject. First of two parallel predicates.
Definite genitive noun with 2nd person singular possessive pronoun -ka. Governed by ʿinda. The possessive makes it intimate — "your" lord, directly addressing the listener.

Indefinite nominative comparative adjective, second predicate of al-bāqiyātu ṣ-ṣāliḥātu. Repetition of khayrun creates rhetorical emphasis — the enduring deeds are better TWICE, in two different dimensions.

Indefinite accusative gerund functioning as tamyīz (accusative of specification), specifying the second domain in which al-bāqiyāt aṣ-ṣāliḥāt are khayrun. Paired with thawāban: one looks backward (return), the other forward (hope).

Noun, active participle (ism fāʿil), Form X (istafʿala → istamaʿa), masculine plural, nominative (marfūʿ).
